terminology.animal_observations: repeated committed appends while rebuilding v['animals']; not formations
terminology.lifecycle_additions: new animals observed on farm tiles and assigned post-placement surrogate IDs
terminology.persistent_ids_terminal: formed surrogate IDs not subsequently removed

method.strong_weak: strong iff final own-minus-opponent money > 0; ties excluded
method.residualization: subtract opponent-by-seat cell mean before Welch unequal-variance t-test
method.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR separately for overall and declared day-by-stage tests
method.replication_gate: q_BH <= .05 plus identical residualized direction in both seed halves and all four leave-one-opponent-out checks
